aColorShowsInThe: A color shows in the table beside the method, and the note in the URL cell and the detail header.
aFilterKeepsThisView: A filter keeps this view's URL, content and triage conditions. Applying one changes this view; the other views keep their own.
aHigherProfileMapsThe: A higher profile maps the same host elsewhere
aNewViewWithIts: A new view with its own filters, selection and scroll position
aProfileFetchedFromA: A profile fetched from a URL, refreshed hourly
aggregateTimingOnlyNoRequest: Aggregate timing only · no request-local trace was recorded
allConditionsMustMatchRemove: All conditions must match. Remove a condition above or edit the filters.
anExactExecutableRuleIs: An exact executable rule is enabled; client CA trust is still required
anyContentFieldMayMatch: Any content field may match; search and scope must still match. Edit the filters or broaden the scope.
appFilterIsActiveRemove: App filter is active; remove it in the condition bar
appsAndDomainsShowHere: Apps and domains show here as their traffic arrives.
asSentAndReceivedCapture: As sent and received · capture bytes
averageTiming: Average: {average} ms · P50: {p50} ms · Max: {max} ms
binaryEncodedOrNonUtf: Binary, encoded or non-UTF-8 field · payload not previewed
binaryUndecodableOrLargeBody: Binary, undecodable or large body: preserved unchanged; headers can still be edited.
blankIsAutomaticPrefers7890: Blank is automatic (prefers 7890). A fixed port (1024–65535) never falls back. Applies after a restart.
bodiesPast64KbAre: Bodies past 64 KB are kept in temporary files. Past any limit the oldest requests go first, with their files; pinned ones stay.
bodyEditsUseDecodedBytes: Body edits use decoded bytes; encoding, digest and length headers are recalculated or removed.
bodyIsNotJsonShowing: Body is not JSON; showing it as text
captureARequestToInspect: Capture a request to inspect it.
capturingTrustingTheCertificateAnd: Capturing, trusting the certificate and choosing what to decrypt.
chooseAMessageToSee: Choose a message to see it in full
chooseAnEncodingAndDecode: Choose an encoding and Decode. JWT signatures are not verified.
chooseExactlyTwoRowsWith: Choose exactly two rows with Ctrl/Cmd-click
choosePrettyRawOrHex: Choose Pretty/Raw or Hex to inspect original bytes.
closeTheClientsOpenConnections: Close the clients' open connections so they connect again
connectionLogSnapshotAtCapture: Connection log · snapshot at capture time
copyAProcessScopedProxy: Copy a process-scoped proxy and CA example
copyTheOriginalCapturedRequest: Copy the original captured request; may include credentials
credentialValuesAreNotAdded: Credential values are not added to filters
credentialsAreMaskedSoA: Credentials are masked so a shared screen or recording does not leak them
dropEveryLocalOverrideAnd: Drop every local override and use Initial values again
editedInTheInspectorThe: Edited in the inspector · the capture itself is unchanged
enableADomainOrA: Enable a domain or a local executable. New connections only; clients must trust the CA. Enabling a rule does not prove decryption succeeded.
encryptedTunnelConnectSuccessIs: Encrypted tunnel; CONNECT success is not a decrypted response
everyRequestReadsTheseWhatever: Every request reads these, whatever the environment. Collection, folder and environment values override them.
exactExecutablePathsNotApp: Exact executable paths, not app names or parent/Helper groups. Add from a captured request or an App's context menu.
exportMessagesNote: Exports {count} matching messages from this {window}-message window, not the complete conversation. Pause freezes the view, not capture. Saving is available once the payload search finishes.
headersCookiesAndBodiesOf: Headers, cookies and bodies of these become readable. More rules in HTTPS rules.
headersOneNameValuePer: Headers · one Name: Value per line; repeat a name for multiple values
hostAndAppMatchExactly: Host and app match exactly. Status takes 404, 4xx, 200-299 or >=400; commas mean OR. Header values use case-insensitive contains on either side. Body searches both sides in full, including spilled files.
hostFilterIsActiveRemove: Host filter is active; remove it in the condition bar
importedExchanges: Imported “{file}” · {count, plural, one {# exchange} other {# exchanges}}
independentFiltersSelectionAndScroll: Independent filters, selection and scroll position
initialValuesAreSharedAnd: Initial values are shared and exported; Current values stay on this machine, in plaintext. Use Vault for encryption.
inspectSourceCaptureUnavailableIf: Inspect source capture; unavailable if it was removed from this session
invalidTimingDataRecordedOffsets: Invalid timing data · recorded offsets are outside the timeline
languageDescription: The language of the app's menus, labels and messages. System follows this computer's language.
largeRequestBodyKeptOn: Large request body kept on disk
localPreviewDoesNotChange: Local preview · does not change or send the request
manageDebuggingRulesAndNetwork: Manage debugging rules and network conditions
mapRewriteBlockOrDelay: Map, rewrite, block or delay matching requests.
messageExceedsTheEditorLimit: Message exceeds the editor limit or is invalid UTF-8. Continue unchanged or drop it.
name: Name
noCachingIsOnConditional: No Caching is on: conditional cache headers will be removed.
noCookiesRecordedOnThis: No cookies recorded on this side
noMatchingCommandsRequestsOr: No matching commands, requests or environments
noOpenDraftsForThis: No open drafts for this source
noPreviousResponseForThis: No previous response for this method and URL. Replay the request to compare responses.
noQueryParametersInThis: No query parameters in this request
noRequestsAreSavedUnder: No requests are saved under it yet.
noWireEvidenceRetainedYet: No wire evidence retained yet; no rule outcome can be inferred.
oneFileWithTheSettings: One file with the settings, lists, rules and the files they answer from, rule scripts, Host profiles and breakpoint templates. Never secrets or variables.
onlyExplicitlyLinkedDraftsAnd: Only explicitly linked drafts and retained runs; never matched by URL.
onlyRunsLinkedToThis: Only runs linked to this request; never matched by URL.
onlyVerifiedSelectedOperationsMatch: Only verified selected operations match; persisted-only queries and unavailable bodies do not.
openHistoricalSessionFilesWithout: Open historical session files without replacing live traffic
originalFilesLeftUntouchedRepair: Original files left untouched. Repair or move the affected file aside, then reload. Other local assets remain usable.
pauseEachMatchingRequestOr: Pause each matching request or response before it continues
pausedViewNote: Paused view · {count} newer messages · capture continues; Resume shows the latest retained window
payloadsAndUrlsCanContain: Payloads and URLs can contain credentials or personal data. Review before sharing.
phasesMayOverlapDoNot: Phases may overlap; do not add their durations. Connection acquisition can include DNS/TCP/TLS. Unobserved phases are omitted, not zero.
phonesAndComputersOnYour: Phones and computers on your network. Needs your consent and an allowlist.
pointHostsAtOtherMachines: Point hosts at other machines for every app using the proxy.
pointOneProgramAtThe: Point one program at the proxy, or open a terminal, browser, emulator or Java app already configured.
protobufReadInPane: Protobuf is read in the {pane} pane.
proxyObservedOnlyPreRequest: Proxy-observed only: pre-request MITM setup is in the connection log. Downstream delivery and estimated throttling are not measured here. Streaming timelines stop at this capture snapshot.
proxyUnavailable: Proxy unavailable · {error} · Local requests remain available
readOnlyComparisonBodiesLimited: Read-only comparison · bodies limited to 8 MiB; truncation/incomplete notices are included
readOnlyMarkdownFromThe: Read-only · Markdown from the collection, folder and request descriptions
readOnlySnapshot1Mib: Read-only snapshot · 1 MiB input · bounded local query
readRulesScriptsHostProfiles: Read rules, scripts, Host profiles and ignore lists from disk again.
readTheBodyFromDisk: Read the body from disk and edit this request
readThisSideInShared: Read this side in shared readers
readsCompleteRetainedJsonOff: Reads complete retained JSON off-thread, up to 1 MiB. Scalar cells up to 4 KiB; unavailable bodies show an explanation. Sorting is lexical.
recordedPerCaptureDurationsNot: Recorded per-capture durations, not elapsed session time. P50 uses nearest rank. Errors include HTTP 4xx/5xx, connection failures and incomplete bodies.
renamingFilter: Renaming {name}. Type the new name, then Rename filter.
replayRequests: Replay {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}
requestHeadersCapturePublicationOffsets: Request headers → capture publication · offsets from 0
requestsSelected: {count, plural, one {# request selected} other {# requests selected}}
reusedConnection: Reused connection: request {number} on it, so no connect or TLS in the wait.
rightClickTheTableS: Right-click the table's header to hide columns or remove this one.
rulesApplyToNewConnections: Rules apply to new connections: reload the page or restart the app you are inspecting.
safeSubsetNoModulesExternal: Safe subset: no modules, external input, updates or definitions. See the guide for dialect limits.
saveCurrentConditionsApplyRename: Save current conditions, apply, rename or delete a saved filter
saveThisRequestToA: Save this request to a collection · Ctrl/Cmd+S
savedTheAppUsesIt: Saved; the app uses it after it restarts
searchSidebarProtocolAndTime: Search, sidebar, protocol and time range always narrow these results.
searchesMetadataAndTheFull: Searches metadata and the full retained payload; spill files are read off the UI thread
sendTrafficFromOtherDevices: Send traffic from other devices and programs through vscroxy.
sendsInCaptureOrderThrough: Sends in capture order through the current rules. POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE can change server data. WebSocket, SSE and tunnels are excluded.
showOnlyTheHostsAnd: Show only the hosts and apps below. Everything else is still proxied, just not recorded.
showTheTrafficListReopen: Show the traffic list; reopen the guide from the command palette
someAppsKeepTheirOwn: Some apps keep their own trust store, or pin certificates; they may need setting up themselves.
statusHeaderBodyMethodDuration: Status, header, body, method, duration and notes
stoppingNoNewSendsIn: Stopping: no new sends; in-flight requests are canceled.
stripCachingHeadersBothWays: Strip caching headers both ways, so every response comes from the server.
systemFollowsThisComputerS: System follows this computer's light or dark appearance.
textLiteralContainsAndKey: Text: literal contains and key:value chips · Wildcard: * any text, ? one character, whole host/path · Regex: Go/RE2 · Patterns ignore case by default
theRequestKeepsItsName: The request keeps its name, URL, Host header and SNI; the proxy dials the address instead.
theSecretsGoToA: The secrets go to a file Wireshark reads (SSLKEYLOGFILE), so it can decrypt this capture. The engine reads the variable once, when it first handshakes, so a change here takes effect from the next launch.
thisRunHasNoRecorded: This run has no recorded capture source.
totalSends: Total: {count, plural, one {# send} other {# sends}}.
traceLimitReachedSomeObservations: Trace limit reached · some observations were not retained
unpinnedRequestsWillBeRemoved: Unpinned requests will be removed from this session. Export any traffic you want to keep first.
upstreamConnectionReusedPreviousSetup: Upstream connection reused · previous setup is not charged again
useNameInRequestsEnvironment: Use '{{name}}' in requests. Environment values override collection values and globals.
utf8TextOrCanonical: UTF-8 text, or canonical padded base64 for binary · 1 MiB limit · opcode preserved
variablesAreReadOnlyClose: Variables are read-only. Close this dialog, repair or move env.json aside, then reload local assets.
whatCaptureChangesOnThe: What capture changes on the way, and what the table shows.
whereVscroxyListensAndWhere: Where vscroxy listens, and where requests go next.
wireEvidenceNotCurrentRules: Wire evidence, not current rules. Redirect hops stay separate; source comparison uses the client result.
writeNonSensitiveCurrentValues: Write non-sensitive Current values into Initial; credentials stay local
writesTheInitialValuesShown: Writes the Initial values shown here, saved or not, in Postman's environment format; Current values are excluded
